", "explanation": "The original setup used a CSS background-image to convey text-bearing information ('TopRate.png'). Since background images are ignored by assistive technologies, this violated WCAG 1.1.1 by not providing a text alternative. The fix involves replacing the informative background image with an `` element directly within the `

` tag. By providing an `alt` attribute with the equivalent text ('Top Rate'), the information becomes accessible to screen readers and other assistive technologies. The space after the image ensures proper word separation.", "effort": "medium" } ```

", "explanation": "Added `role=\"checkbox\"` to the `` element to programmatically identify it as a checkbox to assistive technologies.   "fixedHtml": "<address>3333 Third Avenue, Suite 300 · New York City</address>",
  "explanation": "The `<h4>` element was incorrectly used for visual styling, misrepresenting the document structure and violating WCAG 1.3.1. It was replaced with an `<address>` element, which semantically identifies the content as contact information. This provides correct structure without implying a section heading. Any desired visual styling (e.g., large bold text) should be applied using CSS.",
  "effort": "medium"
}
